items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I remember Sonny Sharrock. He played with a lot of distortion on his guitar. That’s all I can remember.

ctx.x: Okay. I was just going to ask about Sonny Sharrock, because . . .
I remember Sonny Sharrock. He played with a lot of distortion on his guitar. That’s all I can remember. A lot of – he played with Herbie Mann’s, and he played with a lot – is he still alive?
